card.title: Two Minute Warning
card.instruments: single distorted guitar, snare and kick, bass

[verse]
Nobody asked me nobody asked

card.note: Density experiment: same lyrics, key, tempo and seed as punk_two_minute, with a thinner band. Testing whether arrangement density is what buries the vocal.
